{{Top}}
{{Quote|That's a little trick he learned from me, when I was interrogated by his spy on Taris. Blast his truth serums and mind probes&hellip;|Nasan Godera|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''mind probe''' was a feature of an [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] that could delve into a captive being's mind and forcibly learn information. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] when captured by [[Cronal]] was subjected to this.
